title: Lapses in Management of Student Loans
what_it_is: Lapses in Management of Student Loans

sections.label: Tertiary education study loan schemes
sections.summary: The passage describes the purpose of tertiary education study loan schemes and the Ministry's response to Auditor-General's Office findings on outstanding student loans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked	the Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (a) what is the purpose of the tertiary education study loan schemes; (b) what is the Ministry's response to the recent findings by the Auditor-General's Office on outstanding student loans; (c) what is the Ministry's action plan in response to these findings; and (d) how will the Ministry ensure that it will not over-react and continue to be sensitive to Singaporean tertiary students with valid reasons for delays in their student loan repayments.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Therefore, for tertiary education, we have provided bursary schemes for students who need additional financial help and a further layer of student loans comprising two schemes.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: First, a tuition fee loan which covers up to 90% of the tuition fees at the undergraduate level.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Second, a means-tested study loan to cover the remaining fees payable and a modest amount for living expenses.

sections.label: Tuition fee loan repayment terms
sections.summary: The passage states repayment of principal and interest starts one year after graduation for diploma students and two years for university students, with minimum monthly repayment of $100.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: For the tuition fee loan, the repayment of principal and interest can commence one year after graduation for diploma students, and two years after graduation for university students.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: In addition, we have set the monthly minimum repayment at $100 per loan, with a maximum repayment period of 10 years for diploma students and 20 years for university students.

sections.label: Student loan default rates
sections.summary: The passage states that 1.4% of the total loan amount outstanding is in default and deemed unrecoverable, compared with about 40% in the United Kingdom and 10%-20% in the United States.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Today, of the total loan amount outstanding, 1.4% is in default and deemed unrecoverable.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: This is not a high default rate for student loans internationally.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: It is about 40% in the United Kingdom and 10%-20% in the United States.

sections.label: AGO comment on fee basis
sections.summary: The passage states that the fee is based on a percentage of the total loan amount outstanding, as pointed out by AGO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As AGO pointed out ‒ and we are appreciative of AGO pointing it out ‒ today, the fee is based on a percentage of the total loan amount outstanding.
